newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Sept 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Sept 11.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The government daily and other UAE newspapers fronted news of the UAE emphasising to the United States, a key ally, of its belief in the need to preserve Iraq's sovereignty and territorial integrity in light of events in northern Iraq.
- Bosnian soldiers graduate from UAE military training.
- UAE to supply two batteries of 105 mm artillery as a gift to the Bosnian government.
- Taiwan's exports to the UAE rose 40 percent to $350 million in the first five months of 1996 compared to the same period in 1995.
